risks: Our business is substantially dependent on certain key customers, from whom we derive a significant portion of our revenues.
The loss of any significant customers may have a material and adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
We derive, a substantial portion of our revenue from a limited number of key customers.

other_material_facts.value: We have projected the working capital cycle to be 107 days in FY2027 and FY2028.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Justification for increase in working capital cycle are as below: Asset-Current Assets Trade Receivables Our Company extends credit facilities to its customers in the ordinary course of business and in line with prevailing industry practices.

other_material_facts.label: debt_repayment
other_material_facts.value: The trade receivable days is projected to decline from 30 days in FY 2026 to 26 days in FY 2027 and further to 25 in FY 2028, due to change in customer mix as we are strategically shifting from B2B to B2C sales and also primarily driven by efficient and strategic debtors’ collection despite the growth in revenue from operations and without disturbing longstanding relationship with customers.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: In FY2027 it is projected to reduce to 11 days due to stocking up of finished goods in proposed B2B and B2C showrooms in Kolkata located at Ezra Street and Rash Behari Avenue respectively and further to remain at same level in FY2028 due to stocking up in proposed new showrooms and setting up of own new plating facility in Baruipur, Kolkata.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: The setting up of the new plating facility is expected to result in faster conversion of work-in- progress (“WIP”) into finished goods, as the labour force deployed at the plating facility will be under the direct control and supervision of the Company, leading to improved operational efficiency and better coordination across the manufacturing process.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: With the proposed facility, such dependency and transportation delays are expected to reduce, thereby improving production turnaround time and accelerating the movement of inventory from WIP to finished goods.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: Further, with the proposed commencement of the manufacturing facility, the production process is expected to become faster and more streamlined due to improved operational control and reduction in outsourcing and transit-related delays, which is expected to support smoother inventory replenishment and more efficient inventory management.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Our company plans to strengthen its financial position by utilizing IPO funds to optimize working capital and accelerate payments to suppliers, which will lead to payment to creditors and reduction in the outstanding days payable.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: Our Company has proposed to utilize a portion of the fresh issue proceeds towards setting up a new plating facility at Baruipur, Kolkata for plating of the Jewellery Mountings goods which is expected to commence its operations during the second half of the FY 2028.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: Since the plating facility is proposed to be in house the creditors against the same will be eliminated and therefore the trade payables holding period are expected to reduce from 63 days in FY 2027 to 61 days in FY 2028.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Working Capital Cycle The working capital cycle is primarily influenced by the nature of operations, which requires maintenance of adequate levels of raw materials, work-in-process, trading goods and finished goods inventory to ensure uninterrupted production and timely execution of customer orders.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: In FY2028, with all locations having completed their initial stabilization phase, our Company expects to maintain normalized display and safety stock levels across all outlets on a sustained basis throughout the year, resulting in comparatively higher year-end inventory balances compared to FY2027, when certain locations were still in the ramp-up phase at year-end. b) Commencement of In-House Plating Facility: Our Company's proposed plating and finishing facility at Baruipur, Kolkata is expected to commence operations during FY2028.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: Accordingly, our Company expects to maintain higher levels of raw material and work-in-progress inventory to ensure continuous feeding of the plating facility and uninterrupted production flow.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: The marginal reduction in the proportion of finished goods inventory from 72.82% in FY2027 to 71.44% in FY2028 reflects the anticipated increase in raw material and work-in-progress inventory associated with the commencement of the in-house plating facility, which is expected to result in a modest increase in the manufacturing-stage inventory components as a proportion of total inventory. 3) Increase in Trade receivables: Trade receivables of our Company are projected to increase from ₹324.58 lakhs in FY2027 to ₹663.44 lakhs in FY2028, representing an increase of 104.40%.
